note: PSA names each engine '<build code> (<family>)' — RHR (DW10BTED4), DJY (XUD9A) — and the family is what determines the oil, so these are matched by family pattern rather than by listing thousands of build codes. Order matters: the more specific family must come first, since DW10F (BlueHDi with SCR) would otherwise be caught by the generic DW10 rule. 65% of Peugeot engine codes carried conflicting specs, up to four different ones for a single code, and whole diesel families (XUD, DW8, TUD5) were recorded as petrol and given a petrol grade. Approval logic per oilspecifications.org: B71 2294/2296 = high-SAPS ACEA A3/B4 for engines with no particulate filter; B71 2290 = ACEA C2 5W-30 low-SAPS for HDi/BlueHDi without SCR; B71 2312 = ACEA C2 0W-30 for BlueHDi with SCR (AdBlue) and the PureTech turbo petrols; B71 2297 = ACEA C3, PSA's own specification for hot and very hot markets, which is why it is offered as the hot-climate alternative to 2290 rather than a 40-weight that would break the low-SAPS chemistry.

engines.source: DV5R = 1.5 BlueHDi (Euro 6, SCR/AdBlue). oilspecifications.org: B71 2312 is required for BlueHDi engines fitted with SCR; ultra-low-SAPS 0W-30.
DW10F / DW10CB = 2.0 BlueHDi (Euro 6, SCR/AdBlue), as fitted to the 308, 3008, 508, C4, C5 and Berlingo. B71 2312 per oilspecifications.org.
DW12 = 2.2 HDi (Jumper/Boxer, 407, Expert). Particulate filter fitted, so the low-SAPS C2 grade is a requirement.
DW10BTED4 / DW10CTED4 / DW10UTED4 = 2.0 HDi 136-163 with FAP (307, 308, 407, C4, C5, Berlingo). Low-SAPS C2 required by the particulate filter.
DW10TD / DW10ATED = 2.0 HDi 90-110 without a particulate filter (306, 307, 406, Xsara, Berlingo). No FAP means no low-SAPS requirement; the high-SAPS A3/B4 grade is correct and suits hot climates.
DV6C / DV6F / DV6E = 1.6 HDi / BlueHDi Euro 5-6 (208, 308, 2008, C3, C4, Berlingo, Partner). Particulate filter fitted; low-SAPS C2.

DV6TED4 / DV6ATED4 / DV6BTED4 = 1.6 HDi 90-110 (206, 207, 307, C3, C4, Xsara Picasso, Berlingo). Very common in Tunisia. Small 3.75 L sump; low-SAPS C2 where the FAP is fitted, which covers the great majority of these.

DW8 / DW8B = 1.9 D atmospheric (206, 306, Partner, Berlingo, Xsara) — extremely common in Tunisia and recorded as petrol throughout. motor-car.net DW engine data and the XUD/DW workshop figures give a 4.75 L change capacity; the manual recommends 10W-40 semi-synthetic for moderate climates and 15W-40 for hot. No particulate filter, so no low-SAPS requirement.
XUD11 = 2.1 D / TD (405, 406, 605, Xantia, Jumpy). Recorded as petrol. Larger sump than the 1.9.

XUD7 / XUD9 = 1.7 and 1.9 D / TD (205, 305, 306, 309, 405, BX, ZX, Xsara, Berlingo). AUTODOC and the XUD9 workshop manual give a 4.75 L change capacity and recommend 10W-40 semi-synthetic for moderate climates, 15W-40 for hot. Recorded as petrol throughout.
TUD5 = 1.5 D (106, 205, 206, Saxo, AX). Recorded as petrol. Grade taken from the contemporary XUD figures; the capacity is a family estimate rather than a manual figure.

P22DTE (2.2, Ford-PSA DuraTorq) and F28DTCR / F30DT (2.8 and 3.0 in the Boxer/Jumper and Ducato-based vans). Commercial-vehicle diesels with particulate filters; the capacity is a family figure, not a manual one.

DJ5 = 2.5 D / TD (Boxer, Jumper, J5), DT17 = 2.7 HDi V6 (407, C6), DT20 = 2.2. Recorded as petrol. Grade is the high-SAPS A3/B4 used across PSA's pre-FAP commercial diesels; the capacity is a family figure rather than a manual one.

XD2P / XD3P / XDP = Peugeot's older indirect-injection diesels (504, 505, J5), U25 and CRD93 the 2.5 units, 8140 the Sofim diesel shared with the Ducato. Recorded as petrol. 15W-40 is the conventional grade for pre-common-rail diesels of this era and suits hot climates; the capacity is a family estimate.

XC / XK / XL / XM7 / XR = Peugeot's older petrol families (104, 204, 304, 305, 504), EC5 the 1.6 petrol, and CFB (1KR) the Toyota-built 1.0 three-cylinder in the 107 / C1. Capacity is a family estimate.
The Prince-family 1.4/1.6 VTi where the catalogue records the family alone, with no build code in parentheses for the pattern rules to see.

The older TU petrol families recorded as a bare family name. Same 10W-40 high-SAPS grade and 3.2 L sump as the parenthesised TU rule below — these are 106/206/306/Saxo-era engines with no particulate filter, not the Prince family.

EB2 / EB2DT / EB2DTS = 1.2 PureTech (208, 2008, 308, 3008, C3, C4). oilspecifications.org: B71 2312 is required for all 1.2 PureTech turbo engines. The wet timing belt in these engines makes the correct grade particularly important.
EP3 / EP6 = 1.4 and 1.6 VTi / THP, the BMW-PSA Prince family (207, 208, 308, 3008, C4, DS3, Mini). B71 2290 per PSA.
EW7 / EW10 / EW12 = 1.8, 2.0 and 2.2 petrol (306, 307, 406, 407, Xsara, C5), ES9 = 3.0 V6. High-SAPS A3/B4; no particulate filter on these petrols.

XU5 / XU7 / XU9 / XU10 = 1.6 to 2.0 petrol (205 GTI, 306, 405, BX, ZX, Xantia), XN1 and XY7 contemporaries. Pre-1998 engines with wider bearing clearances; 10W-40 is the conventional grade and suits hot climates.
TU1 / TU3 / TU5 / TU9 = 1.0 to 1.6 petrol (106, 206, 207, 306, Saxo, C3, Berlingo, Partner) and the ET3 1.4 16v. Small 3.2 L sump. Very common in Tunisia.
